channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro cria site 'anti-fake news' em que se compromete com ajuste do mínimo pela inflação
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) launched a website to combat fake news and, in his government plan, does not promise a real increase in the minimum wage, pledging only an adjustment based on inflation. The initiative reinforces his campaign focused on the economy and fighting misinformation.

item.title: Lula e Flávio terão desafios distintos para governar
item.description: In the October 25 runoff, the race between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) poses distinct governing challenges. Lula seeks re-election for a fourth term, tackling inflation, public security and structural reforms; Flávio must consolidate a conservative agenda focused on security, economic liberalization and traditional social stances. Both candidates will need to build congressional alliances to advance their governing agendas.

item.title: Flávio venceu em 86% dos locais de votação em áreas de milícias no Rio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro won 86% of polling stations in areas controlled or influenced by militias in Rio de Janeiro, outperforming Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The analysis, based on the Armed Groups Map, reveals strong ties between the Bolsonaro family and militias, including staffing and parliamentary amendments benefiting individuals linked to criminal organizations. The race reflects deep polarization and historical connections between political power and armed groups in the state.

item.title: Ala do STF vê Lei da Dosimetria como alternativa à revisão criminal de Bolsonaro
item.description: A wing of the Supreme Federal Court (STF) supports reviewing the 'Dosimetry Law' as an alternative to criminal revision requests filed by Jair Bolsonaro, who seeks to annul his conviction in the coup plot. The law, enacted in 2025, allows sentence reductions for those convicted in the January 8 attacks, including Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest. The dosimetry review is seen as more feasible in the Court than criminal revision, which would require overturning a established ruling by the First Panel.

item.title: 'Mea culpa' petista vai além da campanha: os erros de gestão e articulação que custaram caro a Lula no 1º turno
item.description: After falling behind in the first round, the PT reflects on governance and campaign mistakes, including outdated strategy and external interference. Criticism highlights failure to counter Flávio Bolsonaro and overemphasis on past achievements versus future proposals.

item.title: PL tem crescimento expressivo na Câmara puxado por discurso ideológico e verba pública
item.description: The PL leads the Chamber with the largest bureau, driven by ideological discourse, public funding, and high re-election rates. Candidates such as Nikolas Ferreira, André Fernandes, and Julia Zanatta increased votes and resources, while pre-Bolsonaro figures like Altineu Côrtes and Luiz Carlos Motta were also re-elected with growth in amendments.

item.title: 'Nunca funciona dizer que a economia vai bem se o eleitor não sente isso', aconselha Karl Rove, arquiteto das vitórias de Bush
item.description: Karl Rove, a Republican strategist, advises re-election candidates to avoid disconnecting favorable economic indicators from voter perceptions. He emphasizes empathy and realism in campaigns, citing examples in the US and Brazil. His analysis is part of the 'Brazil through foreign eyes' series examining international lessons for local elections.

item.title: Vitória de Flávio no 1º turno faz PL articular anistia para tirar Jair Bolsonaro da prisão em 2026
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's first-round victory reignited discussions about a potential amnesty for Jair Bolsonaro, with the PL and allies in Congress seeking parliamentary support. With a majority of legislators, the party explores avenues to overturn the former president's conviction for attempted coup, alongside negotiations with the STF and evangelical campaigning. The strategy aims for Jair to be released by 2026 and attend his son's inauguration in 2027.

item.title: Tarcísio projeta reforma no secretariado em SP com menos espaço para o PSD de Kassab
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas plans to reform his São Paulo cabinet after his second term inauguration, aiming to reduce the influence of the PSD, which had significant representation in his first term. The "less politicized" approach in public security is expected to continue, while changes in the Health Secretariat are under review. The governor is set to distance himself from the PSD president, Gilberto Kassab, and prioritize allies with fewer electoral ties.

item.title: Flávio e Lula disputam 706 mil votos "sem dono" no DF e Entorno
item.description: In the first round of the presidential election, over 706,000 voters in the Federal District and surrounding areas cast blank or null votes. Flávio Bolsonaro led with 51.31% in the DF, defeating Lula, who received 38.11% of the votes. High abstention rates may influence the runoff between the two candidates.

item.title: O que são "fandoms", grupos que fazem ato pró-Lula no MASP neste domingo
item.description: Fandoms are fan groups that form parasocial relationships with idols, organizing supportive events such as the pro-Lula rally at MASP. These collectives also promote social actions and influence legislation, showing strong digital and cultural engagement.

item.title: Irreverência e 300 leis aprovadas: Carlos Minc analisa derrota nas urnas após 40 anos na Alerj
item.description: Carlos Minc, after 40 years in Alerj and 10 consecutive re-elections, faces his first electoral defeat and reflects on his political trajectory, highlighting the 300 laws approved and his history of resistance against the military dictatorship. Despite the loss, he states he is not stepping away from political activity and reveals future plans, without ruling out new candidacies.

item.title: Polarização que afasta: em 12 anos, abstenção no DF saiu de 11,6% para 19%
item.description: Voter abstention in the Federal District rose from 11.67% in 2014 to 18.9% in 2026, mirroring voter fatigue with a polarized political debate. A UnB survey reveals that 44% of respondents find campaign discussions stressful. Analysts warn this growing divide may be pushing voters away from the polls.

item.title: Cultura: o que Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro propõem para o setor
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro present different views on culture: Lula treats it as a strategic public policy linked to democracy and economic development, while Bolsonaro emphasizes freedom of expression and preservation of traditions. Both highlight Brazilian cultural diversity but disagree on the state's role in promoting the arts.

item.title: Flávio e Lula têm de cumprir promessa de ir aos debates
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva agreed to participate in debates during the second phase of the 2026 presidential election, following resistance in the first round. With a tight race, debating ideas is essential for voters to compare proposals and make an informed decision.

item.title: Eleição de mais mulheres para o Legislativo deve ser celebrada
item.description: 109 federal deputies, 12 senators, and 218 state deputies were elected, marking a significant increase in female presence in the Legislative branch. Despite still being far from the population proportion (51.5%), the evolution shows the effectiveness of the 30% reservation quota for women. The news stands out as a consistent advance in Brazilian political representativeness.

item.title: Padilha diz que relatos de Vorcaro sobre propinas são “farsa”
item.description: Health Minister Alexandre Padilha denied Daniel Vorcaro's accusations regarding a bribery scheme at Banco Master, calling them a 'farce' and attributing them to a setup by Flávio Bolsonaro. The PGR and Federal Police reportedly dismissed the claims due to lack of evidence. The case involves alleged 10% bribes to facilitate R$10 billion in investments.

item.title: Caso Master completa um mês suspenso na presidência do STF com pedidos de soltura e apuração aguardando análise
item.description: A month ago, STF President Luiz Edson Fachin suspended the Master case, which investigates alleged fraud and corruption involving banker Daniel Vorcaro. The suspension has stalled requests for release and investigation pending review by the STF Presidency, drawing criticism from investigators and legal experts. Vorcaro's defense team continues to push for his release amid an ongoing institutional crisis at the Supreme Court.

item.title: O teatro da barbárie que dá voto, nos EUA de Trump e aqui
item.description: Donald Trump authorized the first public execution in the US in 90 years, broadcast live, to mobilize Republican bases ahead of legislative elections. Meanwhile in Brazil, the armed wing gains strength in elections with candidates linked to lethal police actions.

item.title: São Paulo vence o Vitória com dois gols de Calleri e celebra retorno de Lucas
item.description: São Paulo defeated Vitória 2-1 in the Brazilian Championship with two goals from Jonathan Calleri and the return of Lucas Moura after injury. The win broke a two-game losing streak for the team.

item.title: TSE dá 72 horas para Flávio detalhar ação contra Lula e Janones
item.description: The TSE gave 72 hours for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to detail an electoral lawsuit against Lula, Alckmin, and Janones, accused of using digital channels to spread false content and misuse campaign funds. Minister Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva also ordered defenses and inclusion of evidence in the proceedings.

item.title: Com centrão e Faria Lima, 5 grupos já disputam eventual ministério de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) advanced to the 2026 runoff election after leading the first round ahead of Lula (PT), and is already being courted by at least five distinct groups vying for influence or positions in his potential cabinet. Among the key players are Centrão and factions aligned with Faria Lima, signaling strong strategic alliance pressures. The competition for roles in a Bolsonaro administration reflects a broad and diverse coalition of political and economic interests.

item.title: A situação de Lula piorou
item.description: The first 2026 Datafolha poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 52% of voting intentions, four points ahead of Lula (48%). Voters from third-way candidates are migrating toward Flávio, and nine million votes that went to Lula in 2022 now support Flávio, indicating a challenging electoral scenario for the PT.

item.title: Flávio quer ampliar mandato, e presidente que ficou 6 anos foi um desastre
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro advocates extending the presidential term from four to six years, referencing the legacy of João Baptista Figueiredo, deemed a disaster in recent Brazilian history.

item.title: Michelle defende vitória de Flávio para “libertar o capitão”
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro took part in a parade in Formosa (GO), advocating for Flávio Bolsonaro's victory in the presidential race to free Jair Bolsonaro, who she calls unjustly imprisoned. After a period of estrangement, she reconciled with her stepson and resumed support for his candidacy, also backing Celina Leão's re-election as governor of the Federal District.

item.title: Nunes Marques suspende propaganda de Lula contra Flávio e Gaspar
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Nunes Marques, suspended an electoral advertisement by Lula targeting the ticket of Flávio Bolsonaro and Alfredo Gaspar for associating opponents with unverified or outdated investigations. The ad used headlines and audio clips that could mislead voters, particularly by omitting that the investigation against Gaspar had been archived by the STF. The ruling is provisional.

item.title: Lula confirma presença em mobilização em São Paulo no domingo
item.description: President Lula confirmed his attendance at the 'March for Democracy' on Paulista Avenue in São Paulo on Sunday (Oct. 11, 2026), starting at 11 a.m., alongside allies such as Geraldo Alckmin, Guilherme Boulos, Fernando Haddad, Simone Tebet, and Marina Silva. The mobilization aims to rally support following the loss of votes in the Southeast during the 2026 elections.

item.title: Cantora Giulia Be casa e leva família Kennedy ao Rio
item.description: Brazilian singer Giulia Be married Conor Kennedy, nephew of Robert F. Kennedy Jr., in a ceremony in Rio de Janeiro. Despite the Kennedy family's alignment with Trump, Giulia and Conor publicly supported Lula in 2022, and both presidents were invited but did not attend the event. Giulia's father, Paulo Marinho, is the first alternate for Flávio Bolsonaro in the Senate.

item.title: Alckmin: Desafio é convencer quem não votou a comparecer no 2º turno
item.description: Vice-president Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) emphasized that Lula's main challenge in the second round is mobilizing voters who did not participate in the first stage. He stressed the importance of encouraging turnout to ensure victory.

item.title: Ratinho Junior anuncia apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro: 'Vamos caminhar juntos'
item.description: The governor of Paraná, Ratinho Junior (PSD), announced support for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the presidential runoff against Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT). The alliance aims to strengthen the conservative base of the PL candidate.

item.title: Voto de Flávio e aliados contra o fim da 6x1 será um presente a Lula
item.description: Senators allied to Flávio D'Avila will vote against ending the 6x1 work schedule, a stance that indirectly benefits Lula's government by undermining labor flexibility agenda. The vote is scheduled for this Wednesday at the Senate plenary session, following pressure from unions and social movements. The lawmakers' stance reflects alignment with progressive sectors and electoral strategies for 2026.

item.title: TSE questiona Meta depois de campanha de Lula apontar ‘interferência’ nas eleições
item.description: The Brazilian Superior Electoral Court (TSE) requested clarifications from Meta following accusations by Lula's campaign that social media content restrictions reduced the president's reach ahead of the October 25 runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro. Meta denied the claims, calling them false and asserting compliance with Brazilian election regulations.

item.title: Gastos: no Brasil em transe, ou Flávio mente aos pobres ou “auzmercáduz”
item.description: The text analyzes Flávio Bolsonaro's spending cut promises, highlighting criticism about how the cuts could negatively impact low-income citizens, and compares his stance with historical figures from Brazilian cinema such as the red senator in 'Terra em Transe'.

item.title: Ratinho Junior anuncia apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro: ‘Vamos caminhar juntos’
item.description: Paraná governor Ratinho Junior (PSD) endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for the presidential runoff. The move follows the elimination of his candidate, Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), in the first round. Other defeated candidates also supported Flávio, consolidating strength against Lula in the second round.

item.title: Lula faz comício em Natal e Flávio participa de moto-carreata no Rio
item.description: Lula held a packed rally in Natal, highlighting social investments in the Northeast and criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro's proposed cuts. Flávio participated in a motorcycle caravan in Rio, promoting a right-wing agenda. Both face security concerns and disinformation during the campaign.

item.title: Cleitinho se explica após críticas por vídeo com Alcolumbre: "Não apoiei"
item.description: Senator Cleitinho Azevedo defended himself against criticism after a video with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, claiming he does not support him and that the meeting aims to approve the PEC ending the 6×1 work schedule.

item.title: Alckmin defende 'falar com a classe média' para virada no segundo turno: 'Mostrando os prejuízos que podem ter'
item.description: Vice-president Geraldo Alckmin stated that Lula's ticket can still win in the runoff, emphasizing outreach to the middle class and independent voters. He cited past political experiences to inspire the base and advocated for fiscal adjustments targeting high earners rather than cutting benefits for the poorest.

item.title: Flávio exalta Bolsonaro e vê culto falar de voto; Lula mira gasolina subsidiada e tesouraço de rival
item.description: On the first Saturday of the 2026 runoff election, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) praised his father, Jair Bolsonaro, during a caravan in Rio de Janeiro, while Lula (PT) supported government measures to control gasoline prices in Natal. The events took place 15 days before the vote, scheduled for October 25.

item.title: Léo Jardim lamenta empate do Vasco, mas vira a chave para decisão na Sul-Americana: “Foco total”
item.description: Léo Jardim regretted Vasco's goalless draw against Remo in the Brazilian league but emphasized focus on the crucial South American final against Boca Juniors. He highlighted fan support and the need to move forward quickly for the match in Argentina.

item.title: Acordão? Jair Bolsonaro solto, Flávio livre de Master e INSS e Moraes ‘esquecido’
item.description: Speculation grows about a potential Supreme Court deal to benefit both Minister Alexandre de Moraes and the Bolsonaro brothers, involving rulings on investigations and controversial contracts. The scenario hints at strategic alliances and Michel Temer's influence, with direct implications for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro fala em “guerra espiritual” durante culto no Rio
item.description: At a centennial service of the Assembleia de Deus church in Rio, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro declared that Brazil faces a 'spiritual war' and criticized opponents using lies to mislead the public. He emphasized his belief in a divine plan for the nation and referred to Douglas Ruas as the officially declared governor of Rio.

item.title: Ratinho Jr. declara apoio a Flávio: “Vamos caminhar juntos”
item.description: The governor of Paraná, Ratinho Jr. (PSD), declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the presidential runoff. The announcement was made after a conversation with Senator Flávio and the governor of São Paulo, Tarcísio de Freitas.

item.title: Justiça italiana marca novo julgamento sobre extradição de Carla Zambelli
item.description: The Italian judiciary has set a new hearing for October 29 to reassess the extradition request of former federal lawmaker Carla Zambelli, convicted in Brazil for illegal weapons possession and assault. Italy dismissed claims of political persecution but demanded more guarantees about medical care in Brazil. The trial will not reassess the Brazilian conviction, only whether the extradition request meets legal and international treaty requirements.

item.title: Ratinho Junior anuncia apoio a Flávio no 2º turno: "Vamos caminhar juntos"
item.description: The governor of Paraná, Ratinho Junior (PSD), announced support for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the second round of the presidential election, emphasizing a partnership with the governor of São Paulo, Tarcísio de Freitas. This move follows the endorsement of ally Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), who is supporting Flávio against Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT).

item.title: Lula transforma “entrega” em mote e cobra Flávio sobre Vorcaro
item.description: Lula launches a new electoral ad for the second round centered on the theme 'delivering,' accusing Flávio Bolsonaro of wanting to hand Brazil over to the US and linking him to Daniel Vorcaro and Banco Master. The campaign highlights achievements such as Pé-de-Meia, income tax exemption up to R$5,000, and the taxation of the wealthy, juxtaposed with criticisms of a 'biased scale' and Flávio's betting activities.

item.title: Ministério do Meio Ambiente afirma que governo do Amazonas pediu ajuda federal para comabte ao fogo, mas desistiu
item.description: The Ministry of Environment stated that the Amazonas state government declined federal assistance to combat wildfires after requesting it on September 23. A federal team including firefighters and an aircraft was mobilized, but the state chose not to use them due to rainfall. The federal government is already active in fighting fires in the region.

item.title: "Exército do Lula": Flávio pede ao TSE suspensão do canal de Janones
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro requested the TSE to suspend the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel created by André Janones, accusing abuse of power and improper use of media. The group, with 3.2 million members, became the target of legal action for alleged electoral violations. Janones denied the allegations and called on supporters to mobilize to prevent the channel's suspension.

item.title: Emails indicam que Flávio dividia conta com investigado na fraude do INSS
item.description: E-mails seized by PF suggest that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro may have shared a bank account with lawyer Willer Tomaz, who is under investigation for money laundering linked to INSS fraud. The correspondence includes a request to remove Flávio's name from the account associated with the lawyer.

item.title: Jornalista argentina pede que Brasil não eleja Flávio: “Terror”
item.description: Argentine journalist Nancy Pazos warned that a victory by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) in the Brazilian presidential elections would result in a 'horror movie', comparing a potential right-wing government in Brazil to Javier Milei's administration in Argentina. During the 'Inteligencia Artesanal' program, Pazos highlighted economic crises, unemployment, and criticism of the economy minister, urging Brazilians not to vote for the right-wing candidate.

item.title: Rodrigo Fagundes fala sobre eleição e a nova etapa de seu personagem
item.description: Rodrigo Fagundes discussed in an interview the new phase of his character Nicolau in Quem Ama Cuida and emphasized the importance of Brazilian cinema. He also addressed the 2026 elections, stating he will vote for Lula and advocating for respectful dialogue among supporters of opposing views.
